label: ERA5-Land
selected_scope: Global ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis, 1950-present, as referenced by GEE hourly, daily aggregate, monthly aggregate, monthly-by-hour and static entries. Multi-product family, not one archive.

download_size.scope: No total selected for the ERA5-Land family; CDS requires user-selected variables, times and area.
download_size.basis: Producer download interface exposes GRIB and experimental NetCDF4 and selectable dates/variables, but no fixed all-family archive byte total. No request submitted.

rationale: Hourly global fields and time-varying variables fit chunked multidimensional Zarr; retain source units, coordinates and variable metadata.
existing_cloud_native: CDS analysis-ready data service; cloud-native object distribution not verified.
caveats: GEE contains several temporal aggregations and a static image; these are not interchangeable with the hourly archive.
Full archive size varies with requested variables, period, area and encoding.

label: JRC Global Surface Water
selected_scope: JRC GSW v1.4 (1984-2021), global mapped layers, yearly history, monthly history, monthly recurrence and metadata; excludes deprecated v1.0-v1.3 duplicates and does not sum separately distributed tiles.

download_size.scope: No fixed total asserted for all global v1.4 products; product families are separately tiled and monthly history is time-indexed.
download_size.basis: JRC describes downloadable mapped layers as individual GeoTIFFs in 10-degree tiles and identifies product families, but the reviewed producer page provides no aggregate byte total.

rationale: Use COG for discrete global summary layers and chunked Zarr for monthly history/recurrence time dimensions, preserving class codes and masks.
existing_cloud_native: Google Earth Engine asset collection; JRC also serves WMS tiles. No cloud-native analytic archive verified.
caveats: JRC download page also advertises v1.5 through 2024; this row follows the top-30 catalog's v1.4 entries.
Monthly History and monthly recurrence contain temporal information and cannot be represented as one static raster without loss.

sources.supports: JRC download mechanisms, GeoTIFF tile delivery, available product types and v1.4 period through 2021
GEE monthly-history v1.4 product identity

label: CFSR: Climate Forecast System Reanalysis Harmonized
selected_scope: NOAA/NCEP CFSR January 1979-December 2010 monthly products as an explicit size-bearing subset of the harmonized CFSR family. Separate UCAR monthly product volume is not the complete hourly or 6-hourly archive.

download_size.scope: NCAR Research Data Archive d093002 monthly CFSR products, January 1979-December 2010; not the entire CFSR collection or GEE harmonized image collection.
download_size.basis: NCAR RDA reports total volume 5.05 TB and WMO GRIB2 for dataset d093002. Publisher unit retained; no byte conversion inferred.

rationale: For a curated variable/time subset, chunked Zarr supports multidimensional reanalysis queries while keeping source grid, time, vertical levels and metadata.
existing_cloud_native: NOAA/NCEP and NCAR RDA provide public download services; cloud-native distribution not verified.
caveats: 5.05 TB applies specifically to UCAR monthly-products archive; hourly and 6-hourly products are separate, so it is not a total-family estimate.
NOAA states CFSR spans Jan 1979-Mar 2011; the measured-subset producer record ends Dec 2010.

sources.supports: CFSR monthly product period, GRIB2 format and published 5.05 TB volume
NOAA CFSR period and GRIB2/BUFR distribution formats
GEE harmonized catalog product identity

label: River plastic inputs (Lebreton et al. 2017)
selected_scope: Figshare v6 PlasticRiverInputs.zip: worldwide modeled 2010 river plastic inputs, 40,760 point records. Distinct from the Meijer et al. 2021 river-plastic model.
native_formats: ZIP archive containing ESRI Shapefile components

download_size.scope: Original Figshare v6 source archive PlasticRiverInputs.zip only.
download_size.basis: Exact producer file size recorded in local source inventory/release manifest; Figshare article API metadata is primary remote source. Local prepared GeoParquet (6,360,991 bytes) and PMTiles (3,705,340 bytes) are separate unpublished derivatives and are not source download volume.

alternative_sizes.scope: Locally prepared, unpublished derivatives only; not public producer downloads.
alternative_sizes.basis: Local release manifest sizes; not included in source download size.

rationale: GeoParquet retains point attributes and nulls for analytic filtering; PMTiles supports compact map display. Keep full-resolution analytical records separate from generalized display tiles.
existing_cloud_native: No exact native cloud-native counterpart established in targeted inventory; locally prepared outputs are not published.
caveats: Source estimate is for 2010; model values are not an annually updated time series.
Four source rows contain null emission estimates; preserve null rather than replacing with zero.
Local derivatives have not been uploaded and are not public downloads.

label: TerraClimate
selected_scope: Original TerraClimate archive, global monthly climate/water-balance variables for 1958-2015 (14 variable series), as defined in the cited product paper. Current maintained series is extended beyond that snapshot.
native_formats: NetCDF (annual files by variable; compressed NetCDF distribution)

download_size.display: about 800 GB uncompressed (publisher-stated in dataset paper)
download_size.scope: Uncompressed payload of all-variable original 1958-2015 archive; not compressed download traffic and not present-day extension.
download_size.basis: Producer paper describes separately stored annual NetCDF files by variable and states archive is approximately 800 GB once uncompressed. Preserve approximate value and scope; no compressed total is given.

rationale: Monthly global variables across years fit chunked multidimensional Zarr; preserve scale/offset, CF metadata, time axis, variable units and masks.
existing_cloud_native: THREDDS/OPeNDAP serves annual and aggregated NetCDF; official GEE collection also available.
caveats: ~800 GB is uncompressed and for 1958-2015 archive vintage, not a compressed-download estimate or present-day total.
Community catalog also includes future-climate scenarios; those are not part of this base TerraClimate size.

sources.supports: Original archive period, annual per-variable NetCDF files and about 800 GB uncompressed size
Current monthly global coverage, variables and annual NetCDF availability
Official GEE collection identity

native_formats: ZIP of raster grid(s) in legacy bulk distribution

download_size.scope: CONUS, 800 m, vpdmax monthly data for all of 2024 only; not all variables, daily history, or PRISM family.
download_size.basis: PRISM producer directory listing gives 49M for prism_vpdmax_us_30s_2024.zip. Listing is rounded, so bytes are not inferred.

label: MODIS GPP/NPP (MOD17)
selected_scope: MODIS/061 Terra MOD17A2H 8-day GPP product for its GEE availability period (2021-present); separately cataloged gap-filled 8-day GPP and annual NPP are sibling products, not summed into one archive.

download_size.scope: No total selected for MOD17 family. Current GEE MOD17A2H.061 is 8-day Terra GPP; 8-day Terra/Aqua and yearly NPP siblings have different granule counts and scopes.
download_size.basis: NASA MODIS land-product format is a multi-layer HDF-EOS container; reviewed producer pages identify cadence, bands and period but provide no fixed archive byte total. Granule downloads not requested.

rationale: COG can serve individual spatial composites; Zarr suits multi-year 8-day and annual product time axes. Preserve GPP/NPP units, QA, scale factors, projection and fill values.
existing_cloud_native: LP DAAC distributes MODIS granules; GEE hosts the listed collections. No public cloud-native array distribution verified.
caveats: MOD17A2H is 8-day GPP, MOD17A2HGF is gap-filled 8-day GPP, and MOD17A3HGF is yearly NPP; they cannot be collapsed into one size without a defined product/version/period.
Current MOD17A2H.061 availability in GEE starts 2021; older collection 006 assets are separate deprecated catalog entries.
